summary.text: Joe Dalia is a Democratic Nevada Assemblymember for District 29 in Clark County, first elected in November 2024. The legislature lists him as an attorney who sat on the Education, Health and Human Services, and Judiciary committees in the 2025 session.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Dalia was born in Boston, Massachusetts, in 1991 and earned a B.A. in political science and economics from Boston University in 2013.
He earned a J.D. from the University of Michigan Law School in 2017, and his page lists membership in the State Bars of Nevada and California.
The page also lists a 2023 Pro Bono Service Award from Legal Aid of Southern Nevada.
